text.en:
Section one of Batas Pambansa Bilang 544 is corrected to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The Cantilan National School of Arts and Trades, the Cantilan Municipal High School and the
Cantilan Barangay High School, all in the Municipality of Cantilan, the Lanuza Municipal High School in the
Municipality of Lanuza, the Burgos Barangay High School in the Municipality of Cortes, the Panikian
Barangay High School in the Municipality of Carrascal and the Carmen Barangay High School in the
Municipality of Carmen, all in the Province of Surigao del Sur, are hereby integrated and converted into a
national institute of technology under the Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports to be known as the
Surigao del Sur Institute of Technology. The principal office of the Institute shall be at the present site of the
Cantilan National School of Arts and Trades and the other schools integrated hereunder shall be maintained
and operated as branches of the Institute."
